properties.state: {"kind":"functional","lineage":"decomposed","name":"A requirement or decision sent to another design (a parent's to its part, or a customer's to a supplier) arrives there proposed, with its origin, and binds only on the receiving owner's word","priority":"medium","provenance":"authored","source":"Anthony, 2026-10-07: rulings on dec:idea-intent-crosses-designs (\"Once accepted\") and dec:idea-gap-flows-to-the-dependency (\"Write-only-at-proposed\"), for slice 3 of the hub work","statement":"When one design sends a requirement OR A DECISION to another (a parent allocating to its part, or a customer levying one on a supplier), the receiving design shall hold it as its own node at `proposed`. It shall carry its origin: the sending design, the sender's node id where there is one, and the version it was taken from. It shall be attributed to whoever sent it. Only the receiving design's owner shall move it off `proposed`. Once accepted, a received decision may govern the receiving design's own nodes. The receiving design shall report what is waiting on its owner's word, and an origin that has moved since it was received. A parent shall see whether each requirement or decision it sent was accepted, dropped or is still waiting. (Decisions added 2026-10-07 on Anthony's word: \"re-plan slice 3 to include Decisions\".)","status":"accepted"}
